# Traefik (HTTPS) — root-context-sse

App at /, Traefik terminates TLS on https://localhost:9443/ and forwards over plain HTTP, PUSH over Server-Sent Events. SERVER_FORWARD_HEADERS_STRATEGY=NATIVE so the push URL is built with the https scheme; no header rule is needed because Traefik derives X-Forwarded-Proto from the entryPoint.

Proxy URL on `https://localhost:9443`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Traefik dynamic config (`vaadin.yml`), mounted into
`/etc/traefik/dynamic`:

```yaml
# App at /, Traefik terminates TLS on https://localhost:9443/ and forwards over
# plain HTTP, PUSH over Server-Sent Events through a proxy that cannot upgrade.
#
# The backend runs SERVER_FORWARD_HEADERS_STRATEGY=NATIVE so that the push URL
# is built with the https scheme and the browser does not block the event
# stream as mixed content. Traefik derives X-Forwarded-Proto from the
# entryPoint's TLS state, so — unlike the Apache and NGINX siblings — no header
# rule is needed to make that work.
#
# The wss-on-upgrade note in https/root-context/vaadin.yml does not apply:
# there is no upgrade here, by construction.
http:
  routers:
    vaadin:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/`)
      entryPoints:
        - websecure
      tls: {}
      middlewares:
        - no-websocket
        - compress
      service: vaadin

  services:
    vaadin:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: http://vaadin:8080

  middlewares:
    # Traefik upgrades on every route, so the only way to build a proxy that
    # cannot is to remove the client.s upgrade intent. An empty value deletes
    # the header rather than setting it empty.
    no-websocket:
      headers:
        customRequestHeaders:
          Upgrade: ""
          Connection: ""

    compress:
      compress:
        excludedContentTypes:
          - text/event-stream
          - text/plain

# Certificates are dynamic configuration, so they live here rather than in the
# shared traefik.yml, which stays scenario-agnostic.
tls:
  certificates:
    - certFile: /etc/traefik/tls/localhost.crt
      keyFile: /etc/traefik/tls/localhost.key
```

The entryPoints and the file provider come from the shared
[traefik.yml](../../traefik.yml), mounted read-only.
